## Project Structure

```
├── manuscript.qmd           # Main research paper
├── preregistration.qmd      # Pre-registration document
├── R/                       # Analysis scripts
│   ├── 00-setup.R          # Environment setup
│   ├── 10-data-import.R    # Data loading and initial processing
│   ├── 20-data-cleaning.R  # Data cleaning and validation
│   ├── 30-descriptives.R   # Descriptive statistics
│   ├── 40-analysis.R       # Primary statistical analysis
│   ├── 50-visualization.R  # Figure generation
│   └── 99-build.R          # Master build script
├── data/
│   ├── raw/                # Original, immutable data
│   └── processed/          # Cleaned, analysis-ready data
├── instruments/            # Data collection materials
├── outputs/                # Generated figures, tables, reports
└── admin/                  # IRB, consent forms, correspondence
```

## Running the Analysis

### Full Analysis Pipeline
```bash
# Run complete analysis
Rscript R/99-build.R

# Generate manuscript
quarto render manuscript.qmd
```

### Individual Analysis Steps
```bash
# Setup environment
Rscript R/00-setup.R

# Process data
Rscript R/10-data-import.R
Rscript R/20-data-cleaning.R

# Analyze data
Rscript R/30-descriptives.R
Rscript R/40-analysis.R
Rscript R/50-visualization.R
```
